title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shaun Wade released by Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles released CB Shaun Wade from the Practice Squad.
items.impact: Wade will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Deguara released by Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles released TE Josiah Deguara.
items.impact: Deguara will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zion Wilson signs with Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles signed DT Zion Wilson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Wilson will add depth on the defensive line for the Eagles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Truss signs with Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles signed OT Xavier Truss to their practice squad.
items.impact: Truss will add depth on the offensive line for the Eagles.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Quinden Jackson expected to sign with Eagles
items.desc: The Eagles are expected to sign running back Ja'Quinden Jackson to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jackson will add depth with the entire Eagles backfield banged up.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Velus Jones Jr. re-signs with Seahawks
items.desc: The Seahawks re-signed RB Velus Jones Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Jones will continue to add depth in the backfield for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Braswell waived by Texans
items.desc: The Texans waived OLB Chris Braswell.
items.impact: Braswell has not played this season. He will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Lance (groin) placed on IR
items.desc: The Chargers placed QB Trey Lance on injured reserve.
items.impact: Lance will miss at least the next four games.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Browning signs with Chargers practice squad
items.desc: The Chargers signed QB Jake Browning to the practice squad.
items.impact: Browning will add depth in the Chargers quarterback room with Trey Lance placed on injured reserve.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Riley Moss (ribs) limited on estimated practice report Tuesday
items.desc: Riley Moss was listed as a limited practice participant on Tuesday.
items.impact: It gives Moss a chance to play in Thursday's game against the Seahawks. He'll need to be monitored on the official injury report on Wednesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) limited on estimated practice report Tuesday
items.desc: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was listed as a limited practice participant on Tuesday's estimated injury report.
items.impact: Smith-Njigba got the same designation on Monday. He should be good to go for Thursday's game against the Broncos.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Judon works out for Jets
items.desc: The Jets hosted LB Matthew Judon for a workout.
items.impact: Judon was most recently released by the 49ers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinton Bell signs with Jets
items.desc: The Jets signed LB Quinton Bell to their practice squad.
items.impact: Bell will add depth in the linebacker room for the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cody Hardy released by Jets
items.desc: The Jets released TE Cody Hardy from their practice squad.
items.impact: Hardy will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Troy Reeder released by Jets
items.desc: The Jets released LB Troy Reeder from their active roster.
items.impact: Reeder will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) to avoid IR
items.desc: Texans DB Jalen Pitre will not require surgery or need to be placed on injured reserve.
items.impact: Pitre is regarded as week-to-week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devonnsha Maxwell works out for Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders hosted DT Devonnsha Maxwell for a workout.
items.impact: Maxwell was one of three defensive tackles to workout for Washington.

items.title: Jalen Hunt works out for Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders hosted DT Jalen Hunt for a workout.
items.impact: Hunt was one of three defensive tackles to workout for Washington.

items.title: Daniel Ekuale works out for Commanders
items.desc: The Commanders hosted DT Daniel Ekuale for a workout.
items.impact: Ekuale was one of three defensive tackles to workout for Washington.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Harrison signs with Giants' 53-man roster
items.desc: The Giants signed LB Malik Harrison to their 53-man roster.
items.impact: Harrison was out of practice squad elevations.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Kendall waived by Bills
items.desc: The Bills waived DB Anthony Kendall.
items.impact: Buffalo plans to sign Kendall back to practice squad if he clears waivers.

items.title: James Proche II released by Browns
items.desc: The Browns released WR James Proche II.
items.impact: Proche will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.impact: Bryant will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.title: Vershon Lee signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed Vershon Lee.
items.impact: Lee will add depth on the practice squad for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Devin Culp signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed TE Devin Culp.
items.impact: Culp will add depth in the tight end room for Cleveland.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Audric Estime signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed RB Audric Estime.
items.impact: Estime will add depth in the Browns backfield. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Jefferson signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed DL Jordan Jefferson to the practice squad.
items.impact: Jefferson will add depth on the defensive line for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Miller waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived WR Ryan Miller.
items.impact: Miller will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) not at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Talanoa Hufanga was not at Broncos practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hufanga is continuing to trend towards remaining sidelined for Thursday's game against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) not at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Pat Surtain II was not at Broncos practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Surtain is continuing to trend towards remaining sidelined for Thursday's game against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Gesky released by Packers
items.desc: The Packers released OG Josh Gesky from their practice squad.
items.impact: Gesky will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Elijah Culp signs with Packers
items.desc: The Packers signed CB Elijah Culp.
items.impact: Culp was recently released by the Colts. He will add depth in the secondary for Green Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mazi Smith released by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins released DT Mazi Smith.
items.impact: Smith had been on the Dolphins practice squad. He will seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster works out for Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers hosted WR JuJu Smith-Schuster for a workout on Tuesday.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster previously worked out for the Vikings. The Chargers wide receiver room remains banged up.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shemar Turner activated from PUP list
items.desc: The Bears activated DL Shemar Turner off the reserve/PUP list.
items.impact: Turner has worked his way back from a torn ACL.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alaric Jackson suspended two games
items.desc: Rams LT Alaric Jackson has been suspended two games for punching Bills EDGE Bradley Chubb after Los Angeles' Week 5 loss.
items.impact: Jackson will miss the next two games for the Rams. David Quessenberry should step in for him.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jared Wayne claimed off waivers by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins claimed WR Jared Wayne off waivers from the Texans.
items.impact: Wayne will add depth in the wide receiver room for Miami.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Raheim Sanders (hip) placed on IR
items.desc: The Browns placed RB Raheim Sanders on injured reserve.
items.impact: Sanders will miss at least the next four games for Cleveland. Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime will backup Quinshon Judkins.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hassan Haskins signs with Patriots
items.desc: The Patriots signed RB Hassan Haskins to their practice squad.
items.impact: Haskins will add depth for New England with TreVeyon Henderson expected to miss time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Irvin Charles (knee) activated from IR
items.desc: The Seahawks activated WR/Special teams ace Irv Charles from IR.
items.impact: Charles will figure to make an impact on special teams for Seattle.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Guillory released by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens released WR Xavier Guillory.
items.impact: Guillory will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Moore released by Ravens
items.desc: The Ravens released WR Chris Moore.
items.impact: Baltimore is expected to get back rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane soon. Moore loses his spot on the Ravens 53-man roster.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Montez Sweat suspended two games
items.desc: Bears DE Montez Sweat has been suspended for the next 2 games for violating the NFL's Performance-Enhancing Substances Policy.
items.impact: Sweat will miss Sunday at Atlanta and the following Thursday vs. New England.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) works off to side during practice Tuesday
items.desc: Jaelan Phillips was seen working off to the side during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Phillips did have pads and a jersey on. It is the first practice out of the bye week for the Panthers. He is hopeful to return this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Dillon working off to side during practice Tuesday
items.desc: AJ Dillon was working off to the side during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Dillon did have pads and a jersey on. It is the first practice out of the bye week for the Panthers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tommy Tremble not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Tommy Tremble was not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Tremble did not have his jersey on during practice to open the week off the Panthers bye. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Monroe Freeling (knee) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Monroe Freeling was not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Freeling did not have his jersey on during practice to open the week off the Panthers bye. His status will need to be monitored in practice the next few days.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cam Jackson (shoulder) to undergo season-ending surgery
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Cam Jackson is set for season-ending shoulder surgery.
items.impact: It is not related to the knee surgery Jackson suffered in Week 4. He will miss the rest of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Pharaoh Brown signs with Colts 53-man roster
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Pharaoh Brown to the 53-man roster from the practice squad.
items.impact: Brown will add depth in the Colts tight end room.
